script: There was one night while training and debugging a model pipeline for me.

props.description: A split-second dissolve between two worlds: terminal green code scrolling (model loss curves, debug logs) fades into warm amber candlelight. A single handwritten line emerges at center: 'and yet.' Feels like the exact moment a data scientist remembers they are also human. Ends on a soft follow / save prompt in the lower-right corner.
